svg.title: Average operation latency in the published Bustle benchmark
svg.desc: Average operation latency in the published Bustle benchmark The original published data marks are retained as a raster layer. Their positions and counts are unchanged. Axes and legends are editable SVG. Raw numerical logs are unavailable.
svg.metadata: Source: 1.png; SHA256: a40dd0dbba60edf680cae105c3643670b9b1676a13f73221d011ade9d0a26784. Crop: (86, 84, 801, 302). The color transform changes presentation only; it does not reconstruct numerical observations.
